about: P2 round 3's Laptop request 7, the A/A pilot (STATE.md; hypotheses-round3.md section 3a), one job per system, drafted in the lab queue's job format for the operator to copy into queues; not a queue itself. Commit: dec7e545869c9b3eb7bf96edfdb4aba8824f8c3c on branch round3 of p2-typed-routing/typed-routing (local; bundled from that checkout as before). It times the Release builds of p2r3-bringup-l and p2r3-bringup-w at 3ff814e50, the builds the probes timed: t3/jobs/pilot.py refuses (exit 2) before the first window unless the clone is clean, each binary's sha256 is the bring-up's and no compiled source changed since 3ff814e50 (none did). No build, no download. A/A only: v2 against v2 in each of the three programs, so no arm is compared with another; its rows set H8's delta and the A/A noise for H9 and H10 by the rule fixed in section 3a before it runs. pilot-summary.json holds validity counts, other processes' largest share and spacing, no rate. Either system may go first; each is quiet-checked at its start.

jobs.note: 1,920 windows: v2 against v2 in the C++ server, the Go program and the Rust program, one mirrored round of four windows at each of 2 shapes x 5 sizes x 16 pairs; server on CPU 14, p2gen on 2 to 13, the runner on 0 and 1; reads ~/lab/p2r3/build-3ff814e50, progs-3ff814e50 and sets, writes only in LAB_OUT. expected_s from p2r3-probe-l's measured spacing: 1,536 windows at m = 10 to 10,000 x 6.05 s = 9,293 s, plus 384 at m = 100,000 x 6.56 s = 2,519 s, plus 12 s to the first window: 11,824 s, rounded up; an upper basis, since v2 starts faster than the probe's slowest arms and sizes 1,000 and 10,000 were not probed. timeout_s about twice that. Boost off, the lab's default.
